name: io.github.bolivian-peru/proxies-sx-mcp-server
description: Residential and mobile proxies and Private modems for AI agents: proxy URLs, stock, rotation, top-up

environmentVariables.name: PROXIES_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: psx_ API key created at client.proxies.sx/account (standard mode). Tick the modems:purchase and billing:topup scopes for the modem and top-up tools. Optional when using x402 wallet mode.

environmentVariables.name: PROXIES_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Account email, an alternative to PROXIES_API_KEY together with PROXIES_PASSWORD.

environmentVariables.name: PROXIES_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Account password, used with PROXIES_EMAIL instead of an API key.

environmentVariables.name: PROXIES_TOOLSET
environmentVariables.description: default lists about 20 tools grouped by buy / use / manage; full lists every API-key tool. Same as the --toolset=full argument.

environmentVariables.name: AGENT_WALLET_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Private key (0x...) of a USDC wallet on the Base network, for the optional x402 wallet mode (no account needed).

environmentVariables.name: BASE_RPC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Custom Base RPC endpoint for the x402 wallet mode.

environmentVariables.name: PROXIES_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: API base URL. A trailing /v1 is accepted. Leave unset unless you run a private API.

packageArguments.name: --toolset
packageArguments.description: default (about 20 tools) or full (every API-key tool)
